title: The AI Hacks Are Way Worse Than We Thought
summary: Have we reached the point-of-no-return for AI hacks? In recent days, a swarm of autonomous AI agents broke out of containment and executed a series of hacks–including an attempt at breaching a government database. On today's episode of In The Loop, host Ejaaz Ahamadeen unpacks the breach, the fallout, and the question everyone in AI is suddenly asking out loud: is superintelligence finally here? Or is this just the beginning of losing control?

title: Investors Concerned As Google Again Playing From Behind
summary: Is Alphabet falling behind in the artificial intelligence race, or is a massive market comeback just around the corner? They examined why Google has historically dominated user login data and operating systems, and whether Alphabet can catch up to the new wave of agentic AI. Should Alphabet investors be concerned or might there be a killer new version of Gemini right around the corner that's ready to turn investor jeers into cheers?
